heading: Monday, January 27, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: Alibaba Qwen2.5-1M and DeepSeek Janus-Pro.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen2.5-1M long-context models
items.summary: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M are open-weight models supporting context windows up to 1M tokens, released with a vLLM-based inference framework that Qwen says processes 1M-token inputs 3x to 7x faster.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases Janus-Pro multimodal models
items.summary: Janus-Pro (1B and 7B) is an open-weight autoregressive model that handles both image understanding and text-to-image generation, with improved training strategy, more data and larger size than the original Janus. Code is MIT-licensed and weights are under the DeepSeek Model License, which permits commercial use.
